how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:lunar-festival-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:8862:completion:0: Very well then - I accept these coins of ancestry. Please take ⟦E1⟧'s candle with my blessing. Also, please enjoy these complimentary fireworks.
rows.quest:8862:completion:1: BMay your Lunar Festival be joyous and filled with merriment, ⟦10⟧.
rows.quest:8862:completion:2: BAnd if you choose to face Omen and his minions, you will find ⟦E1⟧'s candle quite useful...
rows.quest:8866:completion:0: It is good to know the people of this land still pay homage to the olden races. I bid you well, ⟦11⟧, and offer you this token...
rows.quest:8867:obj:0: Launch 8 Lunar Fireworks and 2 Cluster Fireworks and return to a Lunar Festival Harbinger at any capital city.
rows.quest:8867:details:0: Every year the druids of ⟦E2⟧ hold a celebration of our city's great triumph over an ancient evil.
rows.quest:8867:details:1: BWe celebrate the wisdom of our elders, share in magnificent feasts and of course... shoot fireworks!
rows.quest:8867:details:2: BFor a small donation you can purchase colorful rockets from our vendor. Try using some of the launchers around here, ⟦12⟧.
rows.quest:8867:completion:1: BNow that you're in the spirit of things, why don't you take this invitation to the festival in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8867:completion:2: BIt's quite an enjoyable celebration, if you have the time to spare. We share food, drink, stories and of course... more fireworks!
rows.quest:8867:completion:3: BOpen the invitation while standing inside the circle of greater moonlight and you'll be transported to ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8868:obj:0: Summon Omen, defeat him and gain ⟦E1⟧'s Blessing. Return to Valadar Starsong in Nighthaven
rows.quest:8868:details:0: The beast Omen was once a hero of this world. A wolf of great strength and fortune, Omen fought beside the heroes of the War of the Ancients until he succumbed to demonic magics. Turning against his allies, he raged across ⟦E3⟧ and carried death and terror in his wake.
rows.quest:8868:details:1: BFinally defeated here, in ⟦E2⟧, Omen now sleeps among the silt of Lake ⟦E1⟧'ara. But each new year, during the festival, he stirs...
rows.quest:8868:details:2: BGather cohorts, ⟦14⟧, and summon and defeat the beast Omen. Earn the blessing of ⟦E1⟧!
rows.quest:8868:completion:0: Very well done, ⟦15⟧. Defeating Omen sent his spirit back to the waters of ⟦E1⟧'ara. Although the beast himself is blessed by ⟦E1⟧ and so cannot die, his anger will subside for another year.⟦16⟧⟦17⟧Your victory is a celebration, ⟦18⟧--a celebration of the might of Omen, of you and your allies, and of the peace you have given this tragic hero of our past.

rows.quest:8883:obj:0: Use your Lunar Festival Invitation in the moonlight to travel to ⟦E2⟧. Speak with Valadar Starsong in Nighthaven when you arrive.
rows.quest:8883:details:0: Now that you have your Lunar Festival invitation, you may travel to ⟦E2⟧! There you will find many revelers, and in the village of Nighthaven Valadar Starsong and his sister Fariel await those eager to participate in the celebration.
rows.quest:8883:details:1: BTravel to ⟦E2⟧ through the greater moonlight and speak with Valadar Starsong; see what prizes you might gain during the festival!
rows.quest:8883:completion:0: ⟦31⟧, welcome to Nighthaven, host of the Lunar Festival! Although our village is normally remote and sequestered from the peoples of ⟦E3⟧, during this time of celebration we open our arms and hearts to all.
rows.quest:8883:completion:1: BEnjoy your visit, ⟦32⟧, and speak with me or my sister again when ready.
